sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Manohar Singh Chouhan - advocate for the petitio  Shri Surendra Gupta appearing on behalf of Advocate G  ORDER Heard and perused the record.

2. This is second bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C) for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.13/2024 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station-Crime Branch, District Indore for the offence under Sections 409 and 420 of IPC, 1860.
The applicant is in custody since 27.04.2024.
Earlier, first bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after four months.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.

In this case as per prosecution Rs.43,70,779/- has been deposited in the account of co-accused Niranjan only who is CEO of the company, out of which Rs.12,74,770/- has NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35193 2 MCRC-50416-2024 been returned to the complainants by him.
It is also submitted that the co- accused has already deposited the amount of Rs.15,50,000/-.
The applicant is ready to deposit Rs.300000/- in two easy installments within three months out of which first installment shall be deposited at the time of furnishing bail bond.
The applicant is in custody since 27.04.2024.
Therefore, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposes the prayer.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the applicant is ready to deposit the amount, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his depositing of Rs.1,50,000/- and furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
Balance amount of Rs.1,50,000/- shall be paid in on or before 10.03.2024 and the same shall be subject to the final outcome of trial.

The applicant shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.

However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35193 3 MCRC-50416-2024 ineffective.
8.

It is made clear that in case of failure to deposit the both installments within the said period, this order shall stands cancelled automatically without further reference to this Court and no application for extension of time shall be considered to depoist the amount.
Certified copy as per rules.
